name: Lines of Symmetry
source:
The lives of six high schoolers are turned upside-down when Isaac, who was once a close friend to a fellow student named Maya, decides to return to school after several years of absence. Isaac; an aloof and often forgetful boy, attempts to reconnect with old friends, but is disillusioned by how much they have changed. Maya; a somewhat-nervous yet mostly steadfast girl, is thrown for a loop when her ex-boyfriend of two years; Jayne, suddenly shows up out of nowhere, and is forced to come to terms with an unresolved breakup.

Every story has two sides in "Lines of Symmetry".

In "Lines" you have the choice of assuming the role of two different characters throughout the course of the story; Isaac, and Maya — of whom are both currently senior students at a highly prestigious Catholic High School in the pacific northwest. You are given the option to switch between the viewpoints of these two characters at the beginning of each chapter to try and understand their different points of view, and to hopefully piece together their currently dysfunctional relationships.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28025]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
六名高中生的生活被徹底打亂。曾經與名叫瑪雅的同學親密無間的艾薩克，在缺席多年後決定回到學校。艾薩克是個冷漠、常常健忘的男孩，他試圖與老朋友恢復來往，卻因他們變化之大而感到幻滅。瑪雅雖然容易緊張，卻是個有主見的女孩；當交往兩年的前男友傑恩突然出現時，她措手不及，不得不面對分手後懸而未決的問題。

《對稱線》中的每個故事都有兩面。

在《Lines》中，你可以在故事過程中扮演兩個不同角色：艾薩克與瑪雅。他們目前都是太平洋西北地區一所著名天主教高中的高年級學生。每章開頭，你都可以在兩人的視角之間切換，嘗試理解他們各自的觀點，並逐步拼湊出如今陷入僵局的人際關係。
